methods_quotes.q: Years of potential life lost before age 65 years (YPLL) and mean YPLL were calculated using standard methodology
Because silicosis primarily results from occupational exposure, only deaths of persons aged > 15 years were considered.
Industry and occupation were coded using the 1980 and 1990 U.S. Census Bureau coding systems.
